recognize_zh: 一顆大型巨噬細胞細胞質裡塞滿被吞入的細胞：上方有分葉核的嗜中性球、數顆深藍圓形核（淋巴球與有核紅血球），以及紫紅色顆粒狀的血小板與碎屑，這是骨髓抹片中典型的噬血細胞。
features: Large macrophage with abundant, granular and vacuolated cytoplasm and a large round-oval nucleus with fine chromatin
Engulfed segmented neutrophil at the upper edge of the cell
Several engulfed dense dark round nuclei consistent with lymphocytes and nucleated red cells
Pinkish-purple granular material consistent with ingested platelets and cellular debris
Adjacent granulocyte (upper left) and a plasma cell with eccentric nucleus (lower right)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing multiple ingested hematopoietic cells, including a segmented neutrophil, dense round nuclei consistent with lymphocytes and nucleated red cells, and granular platelet material. The ingested elements are enclosed within the cytoplasm. Adjacent cells include a granulocyte and a plasma cell. In a patient with T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, the findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis, raising concern for lymphoma-associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis occurs within megakaryocytes with lobulated nuclei, and the enclosed cells remain intact rather than being digested.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris of varying size rather than recognizable intact neutrophils, red cells and platelets.
Overlapped cells lie outside the macrophage vacuoles with separate focal planes and no surrounding phagocytic halo.
Histiocytic sarcoma shows marked nuclear atypia and pleomorphism, whereas this macrophage has a bland nucleus.
